subject: Executive override needed — Hosted API tier adjustment (22% off)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Apr 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: exec oversight for Statera — 22% hosted rate ask

Ben / Mina — looping you both in. Quick background: Statera Health (prospect -> strategic) just sent an updated commercial ask: they want a 22% discount off list Hosted API usage rates for a 24-month committed program. Our standard delegated approval caps at 20% for this segment.

Why this matters: Statera is proposing a firm 24-month commitment, 6-figure ARR in year 1, multi-region (US + EU) rollouts, and wants marketplace listing co-marketing as part of the agreement. They are on a compressed procurement timeline — they need commercial terms by next week to secure a board sign-off.

I've attached the draft MSA (Statera_MA_Final_v3.pdf), our internal pricing model (Deal_Pricing_Model.xlsx), and their Q1 usage export (Usage_Summary_Q1.csv).

Ask: I recommend we grant a one-time executive override to 22% provided we lock two conditions: 1) minimum 6 months prepay or 12 months committed with monthly invoicing and a 6-month ramp clawback clause; 2) scope-limited to Hosted API (no marketplace credits for first 6 months) and explicit usage caps tied to model families.

Rationale: preserves unit economics (with prepay), gets us strategic entry into a high-visibility customer in oncology analytics, and creates a potential marketplace funnel. Without an exception we risk losing the deal to a competitor who has already offered deep upfront credits.

Can I get a final call: Ben, Marcus, Stephanie, can one of you sign off for execs or route to the appropriate approver? Mina — need your margin sensitivity check ASAP.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Statera_MA_Final_v3.pdf (draft), Deal_Pricing_Model.xlsx, Usage_Summary_Q1.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Apr 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: exec oversight for Statera — 22% hosted rate ask

Vivek — thanks for the clear summary. I support the override request conditionally. Statera is strategic for our oncology partnerships and their product integrations help surface Redwood in three potential accounts.

I concur with the conditions you listed (prepay or committed term + scope limits). From a go-to-market perspective I want a clause that requires a joint customer case study/PR within the first 9 months — that makes the commercial concession tied to measurable GTM value.

Mina — appreciate your quick look on margin impact. Marcus / Stephanie — if you can counter-sign here or route to execs, we can get this to the customer by Monday.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Apr 2028 12:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: exec oversight for Statera — 22% hosted rate ask

Team — did a rapid P&L sensitivity on the attached pricing model. A 22% list discount reduces gross margin headroom materially versus our 20% threshold, particularly if usage skews to high-token models during onboarding. Two mitigating asks before I can greenlight: 1) require a six-month prepay (preferred) or an irrevocable letter of credit; 2) add a usage-based true-up at month 6 with an automatic price step if actual sustained usage exceeds forecast by >30%.

If those conditions are included I'm comfortable recommending approval to the CFO/Finance committee. Without them I need to escalate to the full pricing committee.

Also flagging precedent risk — if we grant this without strict guardrails we'll hear similar asks from other strategic trials. We should log this as an exception case in the pricing playbook.

Mina Haddad
VP, Finance — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@staterahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Apr 2028 15:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial terms — Statera commitment details

Vivek / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming for clarity: Statera is prepared to commit to a 24-month agreement with a minimum monthly commitment that maps to the numbers in the attached usage summary. We can do a 6-month prepayment to accelerate the discount and provide procurement the PO by COB Monday if we have terms today.

We agree to the joint case study ask and are fine with a month-6 true-up clause. We do need the 22% to hit our internal budgeting and board approval. Please send a term sheet reflecting the 22% with the prepay and true-up language so I can route to our legal and procurement.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Chief Financial Officer
Statera Health

Attachment: Statera_PO_Stub.pdf (PO stub, procurement timeline)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Apr 2028 17:21:00 -0700
Subject: Recommendation & conditions for 22% override — Statera Health

Mina — thanks for the sensitivity. Quick recommended decision: APPROVE 22% one-time override with these signed conditions embedded in the SOW: 1) 6-month prepay OR irrevocable LOC; 2) hard model-family caps (GPT-4 class and above excluded from the discounted band for first 6 months); 3) month-6 true-up with automatic pricing step if >30% variance; 4) joint case study and co-marketing commitment within 9 months; 5) clause that prevents resale/transfer and limits to production/testing for Statera only.

If Finance and Legal accept, I will endorse this to the CEO for final sign-off. This balances GTM value and margin protection. Please confirm you can commit to drafting the term sheet with those clauses by end of day Sunday so we can meet the customer deadline.

Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships & Growth
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Apr 2028 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Executive endorsement provided — 22% for Statera (conditions accepted)

All — I reviewed the thread and spoke with Finance. Executive endorsement GRANTED for a 22% Hosted API discount to Statera Health, subject to the five conditions Marcus listed and completion of a short exception memo logged to pricing_playbook@redwood.com.

Vivek / Ben: please circulate a one-page term sheet that includes the prepay/LOC language, model-family exclusion, month-6 true-up mechanics, and the co-marketing commitment. Legal will do a light redline; Finance will sign the exception memo. Once Statera returns the PO we will route a DocuSign packet with the SOW and the exception memo as an addendum.

Stephanie Nguyen
SVP, Commercial Operations (on behalf of Executive Pricing Committee)
Redwood Inference

Forwarded notes: approval is limited to Hosted API usage tiers only; no marketplace credits for the first 6 months.
